items.title: Frank Murray Interview, 1960-05-12
items.q: Now, my voice playing was with the Fireman George band. A band by the name, they called him Fireman George. He was an old fireman, a volunteer fireman. And who was in that band with me was Happy Goldston. He played drum. I played the flute in the band.

ctx.x: And what about your relatives in Livingston? What were their names? Oh, Batiste. Batiste. Can you give me the instruments they played? Well, my uncle played violin. And his name? His name? His name?

His name was John Batiste. My grandfather was a guitar player. My uncle, his brother, my mother's brother is John Batiste. My grandfather's brother's name was Charlie Batiste. He was a guitar player. Both of them was guitar players. And what kind of style did they play? Well, they played the, back in that, what do you call it, real style in that time. There wasn't no jazz out there in them times. They played more reals and calling figures. That was more popular out back in those days until jazz, jazz, come up to…
Is that a flute like this or like this?
